# Values plotted in the figures of research-paper.pdf (tab-separated, one block per figure).
# Generated by scripts/make_figures.py from results/*.csv; do not edit by hand.
# 'ratio' = running time divided by the time of Dijkstra with a binary heap on the same graph and
# start vertex, geometric mean over start vertices. 'per arc' = count divided by the number of arcs m.
# Algorithms: dijkstra = binary heap with lazy deletion, dijkstra-dk = heap with DecreaseKey,
# bmssp25 / bmssp26 = the 2025 / 2026 algorithm of Duan et al. (BMSSP-25 / BMSSP-26 in the paper).
# Layout of a block: a title line starting with '##', plotting instructions in lines starting
# with '#', then one header line with the column names, then the data rows.
# In a spreadsheet: paste the header line and the rows; the columns separate at the tabs.
